directorProcedureRecord.procedure:
PG9-Q01 — KEEP all seven placements and exact classAccess rows. Each ordinary cast uses the selected acquired class, its school, rank9, base26RP, V/S/F and real beginning hooks. Gate: Cleric Universal, Druid/Mage/Wizard Conjuration; the Transmutation placement grants no class route. Absolute Gate has no Druid route; Fortress has no Cleric route. Action for four; Absolute Gate requires600seconds. No generic upcast or Ritual tag. Spell-local completion never supplies acquisition.

PG9-Q02 — KEEP distinct source authority. Use existing plane/site identifiers with an actual geometric site record; generated cells and fortresses receive cast-owned spellSpace IDs, never names of canonical dominions. Source-backed named realms can be named without asserting site geometry or that mortal labels are identical. No Fire=Bastion, Shadowfell=Veiled Expanse, soul/native-plane inference or viewer-coordinate distance. Conditional test geometry is labelled fixture input, not a campaign discovery.

PG9-Q18 — NEW provenance predicate: every causal effect root records actual creation plane, original source/cast, parent lineage and emission event. A spell cast elsewhere retains that plane for all its ongoing outputs, transferred applications and copied/reflected descendants. A genuinely independent later cast starts a new root at the real caster's current plane. Ordinary weapon/physical force roots arise at their actual release/force-generation event; carried weapon manufacture/native wielder origin does not label all later attacks. A remote ongoing environmental source retains its real generating plane. Existing inert matter, identity, gravity/support and completed outcomes are not retroactively removed effects. Missing provenance is a held predicate, never deduced from damage type/theme.

PG9-Q19 — NEW Planar Sanctuary forms one fixed30ft-radius sphere centered within120ft with actual caster line of effect; ward volume is clipped by solid center-line obstruction. Concentration up to600elapsed seconds from formation. Source Instantaneous denotes establishment only. Choose exactly one independently established planeKey (or actual previously created spellSpace identity), including the current formation plane. NEW the fixed boundary has an ordinary faint visible manifestation, permitting source-specific targeting without revealing selected plane, protected inventory or private provenance. Its source clock starts on the instantaneous successful resolution at the cast timestamp; subsequent bookkeeping events confer no new duration. Boundary contact alone does not enter; positive-volume intersection protects only those actual local target/application parts within the volume. Same entity moving out loses prospective protection outside; no duplicate save or refreshed source clock.

PG9-Q20 — KEEP broad effects immunity, not resistance. NEW before resolution, a selected-origin causal effect cannot alter protected recipients/objects/regions: damage, harmful conditions, control, beneficial healing/buffs, ongoing auras, supernatural information acquisition or transport establishment alike. Covered physical blows/projectiles cannot deliver their selected-origin impact while protected; objects are not deleted and ordinary matter passage is not a wall. Local unblocked independent attacks remain real. Ongoing attached effects are locally ineffective while protected but keep original histories/deadlines; completed damage, already learned facts and consumed resources are not undone. No creature exclusion or suppression merely for being born/arrived from that plane. Ordinary voluntary locomotion and voluntary resource expenditure are creature agency, not incoming causal effects; this ward does not immobilize its occupants or make casting free. Nonselected roots work normally; immunity to a source does not create new sensory knowledge.

PG9-Q21 — NEW root lineage survives source travel, reflection, Reversal, Spell Theft and authorized copy. Theft changes recipient, not casting owner/concentration/root plane; Reversal changes only its selected output, never origin. A clone image is not a casting actor. Actual independent local recast has new paid commitment and source root. Original preexisting effects are suppressed only for protected local influence, return only if still live, and miss no queued pulse. No transferred buff gains a new lifetime. Public feedback says only normal observable success/failure, never private provenance or hidden target/source counts.

PG9-Q22 — NEW bounded self-consistency: the sanctuary parent does not prevent its own establishment/maintenance, and its immunity does not block a valid removal/suppression operation specifically resolving against that parent. NEW PG200-SANCTUARY-PAIR: these Planar Sanctuary parent establishment/maintenance expressions do not immunize against one another; their actual protected volumes combine without a cancellation loop. This finite same-family exception supplies no access, free cost, second concentration, outside payload exemption or global immunity rule. Each real removal operation ignores only its own target parent's immunity; another actual Sanctuary still protects against that operation where its chosen-plane and volume predicates apply. A real Null field still applies independently. Countering before establishment retains ordinary rules. For self-plane selection, all other selected-origin effects are treated normally by the predicate, including friendly ones and subsequent local casts. Suppression disables the ward's local protection without pausing concentration/deadline; dispel ends it. Overlap is union of actual protected volumes, never immunity to unspecified planes or recursive cancellation. No refund or retroactive change.

PG9-Q29 — NEW stable event/cast/transit IDs, snapshot graphs and parent-owned cleanup. Process mandatory scheduled ends before a simultaneous new optional crossing. Each crossing commits once; callback duplicate returns its existing receipt. Loops require new real movement costs and actor opportunities, never a recursive free transit. No nested-source cleanup may delete external identities or refund spent costs. Cross-source conflict uses current actual initiative order, then predeclared stable IDs outside initiative. Hidden preflight does not expose protected site/type/ward data. Unsupported nested-anchor relationships remain precise holds pending a compatible source contract.

PG9-Q30 — Select full authored procedures plus all original case obligations and distinct source-qualified branches. Preserve exact native card JSON unchanged alongside every NEW clause. Conditional fixture bodies and terrain are not asserted campaign facts. Acceptance requires the demonstrated branches, source access, clocks and inverses; a green checksum never substitutes for a missing semantic witness. Source/content/geometry/runtime/implementation/human-play/balance/cosmology/domain/completion/release boundaries persist. No canonical changes or application.

GATE129-ADD02 — Adopt explicit persistent geometry/access/material/work records and stable provenance in PG9-Q18–Q28. Current Magic7 accepted envelope and receipts are independently rebound. No transfer/copy operation manufactures a new root or inherits new casting rights; actual spell-specific positive witnesses are required.
